xiaomi.account.title: Xiaomi Home account
xiaomi.account.note: France / Europe region. The password is sent to Xiaomi over HTTPS and is not retained. On this local HTTP connection, entry travels unencrypted to Moli. The camera needs Internet to start streaming.
xiaomi.account.busy: Another Xiaomi login is in progress.
xiaomi.account.failed: Xiaomi connection failed. Check the account, region and video relay.
xiaomi.account.not_found: Device not found at its configured address, or unsupported model.
xiaomi.account.saved: Account saved in the encrypted vault
xiaomi.vacuum.title: Vacuum
xiaomi.vacuum.read_only: Robot not connected. Commands will be available after connection.
xiaomi.vacuum.failed: Command refused or vacuum unavailable. No whole-floor cleaning will be started.
xiaomi.vacuum.unavailable: Local vacuum unreachable or model not recognised.
xiaomi.zone.title: Kitchen zone
xiaomi.zone.note: The vacuum may cross the living room to reach the kitchen. Confirm the zone again if the map or dock changes. No whole-floor fallback.
xiaomi.zone.draw: Draw the kitchen rectangle on the map. The yellow dot is the dock. Check orientation and bounds before confirming.
xiaomi.zone.coordinates: Precise coordinates in metres (vacuum reference frame)
xiaomi.zone.required: Confirm the kitchen zone on the current map first.
xiaomi.zone.changed: Map, dock or bounds changed. Reload the map and confirm the kitchen.
xiaomi.zone.saved: Kitchen zone saved without starting the vacuum.
xiaomi.vacuum.busy: The vacuum is busy. Pause it before starting kitchen cleaning.
xiaomi.zone.map_local: Local robot connection failed. No movement started.
xiaomi.zone.map_not_ready: The robot has not provided a map yet. Try again shortly.
xiaomi.zone.map_session: Xiaomi session unavailable. Reconnect the Xiaomi Home account.
xiaomi.zone.map_metadata: Xiaomi did not provide a usable map link.
xiaomi.zone.map_download: Could not download the Xiaomi map.
xiaomi.zone.map_decode: Map format unsupported or dock reference missing.
xiaomi.zone.map_retry: The robot is preparing the map (retry response). Try again shortly.
